new_findings.title: Task brief passed as argv to claude subprocess — visible on process list
new_findings.detail: defaultHaikuCall in auto-router.ts passes the full router prompt (which includes the user-supplied task brief) as a positional CLI argument after --print. On Linux this is visible to all local users via /proc/<pid>/cmdline and ps aux. The inline comment acknowledged this but dismissed it as acceptable; task briefs routinely contain proprietary business context and repo details that should not be world-readable on a shared VPS.
new_findings.fix_sketch: Pipe the prompt to the child's stdin rather than passing it as an argv token. Use spawn with stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] and write the prompt synchronously then call stdin.end() before the 3-second CLI stdin-wait window fires. The AbortSignal already handles timeout; the separate timeout: option on execFile is redundant.
